name: Git Force Push (Lease-Bound)
description: Force push the current HEAD to an explicit topic branch with --force-with-lease and explicit remote-head validation.

guardrail_repo.description: Path to the Guardrail checkout that contains the force-push wrapper

repo_path.description: Relative path to the target git repository

expected_head.description: Expected local HEAD SHA (full or abbreviated) before pushing

expected_remote_oid.description: Expected full remote branch oid for --force-with-lease

steps.description: Validate lease preconditions and push current HEAD with --force-with-lease.

constraints: branch must be an explicit topic branch and cannot be protected
The wrapper requires expected_head and expected_remote_oid for lease safety
The wrapper validates current HEAD and current remote branch OID before push
invariants: The recipe only performs one bounded git push invocation via the bundled wrapper
A lease token mismatch fails before push side effects
Detached-head and upstream branch mismatch are blocked before push
